title: biatec_login authorization detail
description: RFC 9396 authorization_details object of a login a relying party asks the user to confirm (protocol 1.2, spec section 3.4). The context strings are untrusted text under the text rules of spec section 15 (relying-party profile). `origin` is added by Biatec OIDC when it has one, never by the relying party.

origin.description: Added by Biatec OIDC when it has one, as the relying party reported it; part of the hashed object.
